ko.title: 사망자 281명, 파괴된 주택 12,000채: 1세기 만에 최악의 지진이 덮친 콜롬비아, 실종자 수색 현장

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: 콜롬비아 서부를 뒤흔든 강진이 발생한 지 2주가 넘었지만, 구조대는 여전히 무너진 매몰 지역에서 수색 작업을 이어가며 실종된 가족의 소식을 기다리는 수백 가구를 위해 생존자, 혹은 최소한의 확인이라도 찾기 위해 애쓰고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## 발생 상황

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: 2026년 8월 10일, 콜롬비아에서 가장 가난하고 오지 중 하나인 초코(Chocó)주의 산호세델팔마르 마을 인근에서 규모 7.4의 지진이 발생했습니다.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: 지진 이후 이미 약해진 건물을 무너뜨릴 만큼 강한 여진이 수차례 이어졌으며, 지진학자들은 이를 21세기 들어 콜롬비아를 덮친 가장 강력한 지진으로 빠르게 규정했습니다.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: 진동은 진앙에서 멀리 떨어진 지역까지 도달했습니다.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: 칼리, 페레이라, 퀴브도, 마니살레스 등 주요 도시에서 균열이 간 아파트 단지부터 건물 완파에 이르기까지 심각한 피해가 보고되었습니다.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: 콜롬비아 대도시 중 하나인 칼리는 도시 내부에서만 수십 명의 사망자와 1,000명이 넘는 부상자가 발생하며 가장 큰 피해를 입은 도시로 떠올랐습니다.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## 계속 늘어나는 사망자 수

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: 콜롬비아 재난관리청(UNGRD)에 따르면, 확인된 사망자 수는 첫 지진 이후 지속적으로 증가하여 최근 공식 집계 기준 281명에 달했습니다.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: 수천 명이 추가로 다쳤으며, 수백 명이 여전히 실종 상태로 남아 있습니다. 이 수치는 구조대가 피해가 심각한 지역의 잔해를 수색함에 따라 천천히 줄어들고 있습니다.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: 수색 및 구조 작업은 지형적 조건 때문에 난항을 겪고 있습니다.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: 초코주의 대부분은 포장도로가 거의 없는 울창한 밀림과 산악 지대로 이루어져 있으며, 지진과 여진으로 발생한 산사태가 고립된 마을로 향하는 구조 수송대의 진입로 여러 곳을 막았습니다.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: 재해 발생 직후 며칠 동안 일부 지역사회는 헬리콥터나 도보로만 접근할 수 있었습니다.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## 보금자리를 잃은 수만 명의 이재민

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: 물적 피해 규모 역시 엄청납니다.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: 정부 추산에 따르면 파괴된 주택 수가 12,000채를 넘어섰으며, 거주하기에 위험할 정도로 손상된 주택도 수만 채에 달합니다.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: 당국은 이번 지진으로 10여 개 주와 수백 개 지자체에 걸쳐 피해가 발생했으며, 수만 명의 콜롬비아인들이 집을 잃고 긴급 구호 쉼터가 필요한 상황이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: 피해가 가장 심한 마을에서는 집을 잃은 가족들이 장기 주거 대책 소식을 기다리는 동안 광장, 학교 운동장, 공터 등에 천막과 타프를 친 임시 캠프가 들어섰습니다.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: 구호 단체와 정부 기관들이 식량, 물, 의약품을 배급하고 있지만, 당국은 대응 2주 차가 넘어서는 시점에도 가장 오지인 지역사회까지 구호품이 도달하는 데 어려움이 있음을 인정했습니다.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 과제

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: 콜롬비아 정부는 피해 주 지역의 재건을 지원하겠다고 약속했으며, 국제 구호 기구들도 국가 기관들과 함께 구호 활동에 참여했습니다.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: 하지만 파손된 인프라로 인해 여전히 많은 지역사회가 고립되어 있고, 수색대가 실종자를 찾기 위해 잔해를 계속 수색하고 있어, 당국은 수색·구조 단계가 언제 완전히 복구 단계로 전환될지 예측하는 데 신중한 태도를 보이고 있습니다.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: 초코, 바예델카우카 및 기타 피해 지역 가족들에게 지진의 당장 닥친 위험은 지났을지 모르지만, 마을을 재건하고 실종자를 찾으며 수만 명을 위한 영구 주거지를 마련하는 더 힘든 과제는 이제 막 시작되었습니다.

zh.title: 281人遇难，1.2万所房屋被毁：深入哥伦比亚百年来最严重地震后的搜救现场

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: 在哥伦比亚西部发生地震两周多后，救援队仍在倒塌的社区中进行搜救，希望能为数百个仍在等待失踪亲人消息的家庭找到幸存者——或者至少找到答案。

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## 事件经过

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: 2026年8月10日，哥伦比亚乔科省（Chocó）圣何塞德尔帕尔马（San José del Palmar）镇附近发生7.4级地震，该地区是哥伦比亚最贫困、最偏远的地区之一。

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: 地震后发生了一系列余震，其中一些余震威力巨大，足以震塌本已脆弱的建筑物。地震学家很快将其描述为哥伦比亚21世纪以来发生的最强地震。

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: 震感波及范围远超震中。

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: 包括卡利（Cali）、佩雷拉（Pereira）、基布多（Quibdó）和马尼萨莱斯（Manizales）在内的多个城市均报告了严重损失，从公寓楼开裂到整栋建筑倒塌不等。

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: 哥伦比亚最大的城市之一卡利已成为受灾最严重的城市中心，当地官员报告称，仅在该市就有数十人死亡，一千多人受伤。

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## 死亡人数持续攀升

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: 据哥伦比亚国家灾害管理署（UNGRD）称，自地震发生以来，确认的死亡人数稳步上升，最新官方统计数字为281人。

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: 另有数千人受伤，数百人仍被列为失踪人员——随着搜救队在重灾区清理废墟，这一数字正在缓慢下降。

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: 地形本身增加了搜救行动的难度。

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: 乔科省大部分地区是茂密的丛林和多山的乡村，几乎没有铺设道路，地震及其余震引发的山体滑坡阻断了救援车队前往偏远村庄的多条路线。

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: 在灾难发生后的最初几天里，一些社区只能通过直升机或步行才能到达。

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## 数万人无家可归

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: 物质损失令人震惊。

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: 政府估计被毁房屋数量超过1.2万所，另有数万所房屋受损严重，已无法居住。

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: 官员们表示，地震影响了十几个省和数百个市镇，导致数万名哥伦比亚人流离失所，急需紧急避难所。

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: 在受灾最严重的城镇，广场、操场和空地上搭起了帐篷和防水布搭建的临时营地，失去家园的家庭正在等待长期住房的消息。

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: 援助组织和政府机构一直在分发食物、水和医疗用品，尽管官员们承认，在灾后几周，抵达最偏远的社区仍然是一项挑战。

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## 前路漫漫

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: 哥伦比亚政府已承诺支持受灾省份的重建工作，国际援助组织也已加入国家机构的响应行列。

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: 但由于许多社区仍因基础设施受损而与外界隔绝，且搜救队仍在废墟中搜寻失踪者，官员们对于何时能从搜救阶段完全转入恢复阶段持谨慎态度。

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: 对于乔科省、考卡山谷省（Valle del Cauca）和其他受灾地区的家庭来说，地震的直接危险可能已经过去，但更艰巨的任务——重建城镇、追踪失踪者以及为数万人寻找永久住所——才刚刚开始。

hi.title: 281 मृत, 12,000 घर तबाह: एक सदी में अपने सबसे खराब भूकंप के बाद कोलंबिया की लापता लोगों की तलाश

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: पश्चिमी कोलंबिया में धरती हिलने के दो सप्ताह से अधिक समय बाद भी, बचाव दल ढहे हुए इलाकों में काम कर रहे हैं, और लापता प्रियजनों की खबर का इंतजार कर रहे सैकड़ों परिवारों के लिए बचे हुए लोगों को खोजने — या कम से कम जवाब पाने की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## क्या हुआ था

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: 10 अगस्त, 2026 को, कोलंबिया के चोको विभाग में सैन जोस डेल पल्मार शहर के पास 7.4 तीव्रता का भूकंप आया, जो देश के सबसे गरीब और सबसे दूरदराज के क्षेत्रों में से एक है।

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: भूकंप के बाद कई झटके आए, जिनमें से कुछ इतने शक्तिशाली थे कि पहले से कमजोर इमारतें गिर गईं, और भूकंप विज्ञानियों ने इसे जल्दी ही 21वीं सदी में कोलंबिया में आने वाला सबसे शक्तिशाली भूकंप बताया।

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: झटके का असर केंद्र से बहुत दूर तक महसूस किया गया।

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: काली, परेरा, क्विबडो और मनीज़ालेस सहित शहरों में दरार पड़े अपार्टमेंट ब्लॉकों से लेकर पूरी इमारत के ढहने तक, गंभीर नुकसान की सूचना मिली।

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: कोलंबिया के सबसे बड़े शहरों में से एक, काली, सबसे बुरी तरह प्रभावित शहरी केंद्र के रूप में उभरा है, जहाँ स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने अकेले शहर के भीतर दर्जनों मौतों और एक हजार से अधिक घायलों की सूचना दी है।

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## लगातार बढ़ता मौत का आंकड़ा

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: कोलंबिया की राष्ट्रीय आपदा प्रबंधन एजेंसी, UNGRD के अनुसार, भूकंप आने के बाद से पुष्टि की गई मौतों का आंकड़ा लगातार बढ़ा है, और नवीनतम आधिकारिक गिनती में यह 281 है।

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: हजारों अन्य लोग घायल हो गए, और कई सौ लोग अभी भी लापता बताए जा रहे हैं — यह एक ऐसी संख्या है जो बुरी तरह प्रभावित शहरों में मलबे को हटाने के दौरान खोज दलों के काम करने के साथ ही धीरे-धीरे कम हुई है।

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: खोज और बचाव अभियान खुद इलाके की वजह से जटिल हो गए हैं।

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: चोको का अधिकांश हिस्सा घना जंगल और पहाड़ी ग्रामीण इलाका है जहाँ कुछ ही पक्की सड़कें हैं, और भूकंप तथा उसके झटकों के कारण हुए भूस्खलन ने कई ऐसे रास्तों को अवरुद्ध कर दिया जिनकी बचाव काफिलों को अलग-थलग पड़े गांवों तक पहुँचने के लिए आवश्यकता थी।

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: आपदा के तुरंत बाद के दिनों में, कुछ समुदायों तक केवल हेलीकॉप्टर या पैदल ही पहुँचा जा सकता था।

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## दसियों हज़ार लोग बेघर

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: भौतिक नुकसान चौंका देने वाला रहा है।

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: सरकारी अनुमानों के अनुसार नष्ट हुए घरों की संख्या 12,000 से अधिक है, और दसियों हज़ार अन्य घर रहने के लिए असुरक्षित होने की हद तक क्षतिग्रस्त हो गए हैं।

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों का कहना है कि भूकंप ने एक दर्जन से अधिक विभागों और सैकड़ों नगर पालिकाओं के लोगों को प्रभावित किया है, जिससे दसियों हज़ार कोलंबियाई लोग विस्थापित हुए हैं और उन्हें आपातकालीन आश्रय की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: सबसे बुरी तरह प्रभावित शहरों में, चौकों, स्कूल के मैदानों और खुले खेतों में तंबू और तिरपाल के अस्थायी शिविर लगाए गए हैं, क्योंकि अपने घर खो चुके परिवार लंबे समय के आवास के बारे में किसी खबर का इंतजार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: सहायता समूह और सरकारी एजेंसियां भोजन, पानी और चिकित्सा आपूर्ति वितरित कर रही हैं, हालांकि अधिकारियों ने स्वीकार किया है कि प्रतिक्रिया के हफ्तों बाद भी सबसे दूरदराज के समुदायों तक पहुंचना एक चुनौती बनी हुई है।

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## आगे का रास्ता

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: कोलंबिया की सरकार ने प्रभावित विभागों में पुनर्निर्माण के लिए समर्थन का वादा किया है, और अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहायता संगठनों ने राष्ट्रीय एजेंसियों के साथ मिलकर प्रतिक्रिया में भाग लिया है।

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: लेकिन क्षतिग्रस्त बुनियादी ढांचे के कारण अभी भी कई समुदायों के कटे होने और खोज दलों द्वारा लापता लोगों के लिए मलबे की छानबीन करने के साथ, अधिकारियों ने यह अनुमान लगाने में सावधानी बरती है कि पुनर्प्राप्ति चरण पूरी तरह से खोज और बचाव प्रयास से कब आगे बढ़ेगा।

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: चोको, वैले डेल कॉका और अन्य प्रभावित क्षेत्रों के परिवारों के लिए, भूकंप का तात्कालिक खतरा टल गया होगा, लेकिन कठिन कार्य — शहरों का पुनर्निर्माण करना, लापता लोगों का पता लगाना, और दसियों हज़ार लोगों के लिए स्थायी आश्रय खोजना — अभी शुरू ही हुआ है।

es.title: 281 Muertos, 12,000 Hogares Destruidos: La Búsqueda de Desaparecidos en Colombia tras su Peor Terremoto en un Siglo

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: Más de dos semanas después de que la tierra sacudiera el oeste de Colombia hasta sus cimientos, los equipos de rescate siguen trabajando entre vecindarios colapsados, con la esperanza de encontrar sobrevivientes —o al menos respuestas— para los cientos de familias que aún esperan noticias de sus seres queridos desaparecidos.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## Qué sucedió

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: El 10 de agosto de 2026, un terremoto de magnitud 7.4 sacudió las inmediaciones del municipio de San José del Palmar, en el departamento colombiano de Chocó, una de las regiones más pobres y remotas del país.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: Al sismo le siguió una serie de réplicas, algunas lo suficientemente fuertes como para derribar edificios ya debilitados, y fue rápidamente descrito por los sismólogos como el más potente en golpear a Colombia en el siglo XXI.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: El temblor se sintió mucho más allá del epicentro.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: Ciudades como Cali, Pereira, Quibdó y Manizales reportaron graves daños, desde bloques de apartamentos agrietados hasta el colapso total de edificios.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: Cali, una de las ciudades más grandes de Colombia, se ha convertido en el centro urbano más golpeado, con funcionarios locales reportando decenas de muertes y más de un millar de heridos solo dentro de la ciudad.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## Un balance de muertes que sigue aumentando

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: Según la agencia nacional de gestión de desastres de Colombia, la UNGRD, el número de muertes confirmadas ha aumentado constantemente desde que ocurrió el sismo, ubicándose en 281 en el último recuento oficial.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: Miles de personas más resultaron heridas y varios cientos siguen figurando como desaparecidas, una cifra que solo ha disminuido lentamente mientras los equipos de búsqueda trabajan entre los escombros de las poblaciones más golpeadas.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: Las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate se han visto complicadas por el propio terreno.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Gran parte de Chocó es selva densa y campo montañoso con pocas carreteras pavimentadas, y los deslizamientos de tierra provocados por el sismo y sus réplicas bloquearon varias rutas que los convoyes de rescate necesitaban para llegar a las aldeas aisladas.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: En los días inmediatamente posteriores al desastre, algunas comunidades solo eran accesibles en helicóptero o a pie.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## Decenas de miles sin hogar

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: El costo material ha sido descomunal.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: Las estimaciones del gobierno sitúan el número de viviendas destruidas por encima de las 12,000, con decenas de miles más dañadas hasta el punto de no ser seguras para habitar.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios señalan que el terremoto ha afectado a personas en más de una docena de departamentos y cientos de municipios, dejando a decenas de miles de colombianos desplazados y necesitados de refugio de emergencia.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: En las localidades más afectadas, se han levantado campamentos temporales de tiendas de campaña y lonas en plazas, patios escolares y campos abiertos, mientras las familias que perdieron sus hogares esperan noticias sobre viviendas a más largo plazo.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: Grupos de ayuda y agencias gubernamentales han estado distribuyendo alimentos, agua y suministros médicos, aunque los funcionarios han reconocido que llegar a las comunidades más remotas sigue siendo un reto a semanas de haber iniciado la respuesta.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## El camino por delante

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: El gobierno de Colombia ha prometido apoyo para la reconstrucción en los departamentos afectados, y organizaciones de ayuda internacional se han sumado a la respuesta junto con las agencias nacionales.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: Pero con tantas comunidades aún incomunicadas debido a la infraestructura dañada, y con los equipos de búsqueda revisando los escombros en busca de los desaparecidos, los funcionarios se han mostrado cautelosos al predecir cuándo la fase de recuperación reemplazará por completo a los esfuerzos de búsqueda y rescate.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: Para las familias en Chocó, Valle del Cauca y las otras regiones afectadas, el peligro inmediato del terremoto quizás haya pasado, pero la tarea más difícil —reconstruir pueblos, rastrear a los desaparecidos y encontrar refugio permanente para decenas de miles de personas— apenas está comenzando.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: Le séisme a été suivi d'une série de répliques, certaines assez fortes pour faire s'effondrer des bâtiments déjà fragilisés, et a rapidement été décrit par les sismologues comme le plus puissant à avoir frappé la Colombie au XXIe siècle.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: Les secousses se sont ressenties bien au-delà de l'épicentre.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: Des villes telles que Cali, Pereira, Quibdó et Manizales ont toutes fait état de dégâts importants, allant d'immeubles d'habitation fissurés à l'effondrement complet de bâtiments.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: Cali, l'une des plus grandes villes de Colombie, s'est révélée être le centre urbain le plus touché, les autorités locales signalant des dizaines de morts et bien plus d'un millier de blessés dans la seule ville.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## Un bilan humain qui continue d'alourdir

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: Selon l'agence nationale de gestion des catastrophes de Colombie, l'UNGRD, le bilan confirmé des victimes n'a cessé d'augmenter depuis le séisme, s'élevant à 281 morts selon le dernier décompte officiel.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: Des milliers d'autres personnes ont été blessées et plusieurs centaines sont toujours portées disparues — un chiffre qui ne diminue que lentement à mesure que les équipes de recherche déblaient les décombres dans les villes les plus touchées.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: Les opérations de recherche et de sauvetage ont été compliquées par le terrain lui-même.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Une grande partie du Chocó est constituée de jungle dense et de zones montagneuses avec peu de routes goudronnées, et les glissements de terrain déclenchés par le séisme et ses répliques ont bloqué plusieurs voies empruntées par les convois de secours pour atteindre les villages isolés.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: Dans les jours qui ont immédiatement suivi la catastrophe, certaines communautés n'étaient accessibles qu'en hélicoptère ou à pied.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## Des dizaines de milliers de personnes sans abri

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: Le bilan matériel est étourdissant.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: Les estimations du gouvernement font état de plus de 12 000 habitations détruites, et de dizaines de milliers d'autres endommagées au point d'être dangereuses à occuper.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: Les autorités indiquent que le séisme a touché des habitants dans plus d'une douzaine de départements et des centaines de municipalités, laissant des dizaines de milliers de Colombiens déplacés et ayant besoin d'un hébergement d'urgence.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: Dans les villes les plus durement touchées, des camps temporaires de tentes et de bâches ont été dressés sur les places, dans les cours d'écoles et sur des terrains dégagés, tandis que les familles qui ont perdu leur logement attendent des nouvelles concernant un relogement à plus long terme.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: Les organisations d'aide et les agences gouvernementales distribuent de la nourriture, de l'eau et des fournitures médicales, bien que les responsables reconnaissent qu'atteindre les communautés les plus reculées reste un défi des semaines après le début de l'intervention.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## Le chemin à parcourir

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement colombien s'est engagé à soutenir la reconstruction dans les départements touchés, et des organisations d'aide internationale se sont jointes aux secours aux côtés des agences nationales.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: Mais avec tant de communautés encore coupées du monde en raison des infrastructures endommagées, et les équipes de recherche fouillant toujours les décombres à la recherche des disparus, les autorités se montrent prudentes quant à la date à laquelle la phase de reconstruction prendra pleinement le relais des efforts de recherche et de sauvetage.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: Pour les familles du Chocó, du Valle del Cauca et des autres régions touchées, le danger immédiat du séisme est peut-être passé, mais la tâche la plus difficile — reconstruire les villes, retrouver les disparus et fournir un logement permanent à des dizaines de milliers de personnes — ne fait que commencer.

pt.title: 281 mortos, 12.000 casas destruídas: por dentro da busca da Colômbia pelos desaparecidos após o pior terremoto em um século

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: Mais de duas semanas após o solo sacudir o oeste da Colômbia até o seu núcleo, equipes de resgate ainda estão trabalhando em bairros colapsados, na esperança de encontrar sobreviventes — ou pelo menos respostas — para as centenas de famílias que ainda aguardam notícias de entes queridos desaparecidos.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## O que aconteceu

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: Em 10 de agosto de 2026, um terremoto de magnitude 7,4 atingiu as proximidades da cidade de San José del Palmar, no departamento de Chocó, na Colômbia, uma das regiões mais pobres e remotas do país.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: O terremoto foi seguido por uma série de réplicas, algumas fortes o suficiente para derrubar edifícios já enfraquecidos, e foi rapidamente descrito por sismólogos como o mais poderoso a atingir a Colômbia no século XXI.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: O tremor foi sentido muito além do epicentro.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: Cidades como Cali, Pereira, Quibdó e Manizales relataram danos graves, desde blocos de apartamentos rachados até o colapso total de edifícios.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: Cali, uma das maiores cidades da Colômbia, emergiu como o centro urbano mais atingido, com autoridades locais relatando dezenas de mortes e bem mais de mil feridos apenas na cidade.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## Um número de mortos que continua subindo

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: De acordo com a agência nacional de gestão de desastres da Colômbia, a UNGRD, o número confirmado de mortos subiu constantemente desde que o terremoto ocorreu, chegando a 281 na contagem oficial mais recente.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: Milhares de pessoas ficaram feridas e várias centenas continuam listadas como desaparecidas — um número que só diminuiu lentamente à medida que as equipes de busca trabalham nos escombros nas cidades mais atingidas.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: As operações de busca e resgate foram complicadas pelo próprio terreno.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Grande parte de Chocó é composta por selva densa e campo montanhoso com poucas estradas pavimentadas, e deslizamentos de terra desencadeados pelo terremoto e suas réplicas bloquearam várias rotas que os comboios de resgate precisavam para chegar às aldeias isoladas.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: Nos dias imediatamente após o desastre, algumas comunidades só podiam ser alcançadas por helicóptero ou a pé.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## Dezenas de milhares sem casa

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: O custo material tem sido impressionante.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: Estimativas do governo colocam o número de casas destruídas acima de 12.000, com dezenas de milhares a mais danificadas a ponto de serem inseguras para ocupação.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: As autoridades dizem que o terremoto afetou pessoas em mais de uma dúzia de departamentos e centenas de municípios, deixando dezenas de milhares de colombianos deslocados e precisando de abrigo de emergência.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: Nas cidades mais atingidas, campos temporários de tendas e lonas foram montados em praças, pátios de escolas e campos abertos, enquanto as famílias que perderam suas casas aguardam notícias sobre moradias de longo prazo.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: Grupos de ajuda e agências governamentais têm distribuído alimentos, água e suprimentos médicos, embora as autoridades tenham reconhecido que chegar às comunidades mais remotas continua sendo um desafio semanas após o início da resposta.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## O caminho a seguir

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: O governo da Colômbia prometeu apoio à reconstrução nos departamentos afetados, e organizações internacionais de ajuda se juntaram à resposta ao lado das agências nacionais.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: Mas com tantas comunidades ainda isoladas por infraestruturas danificadas, e com equipes de busca ainda vasculhando os escombros em busca dos desaparecidos, as autoridades têm sido cautelosas ao prever quando a fase de recuperação assumirá totalmente o lugar do esforço de busca e resgate.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: Para as famílias em Chocó, Valle del Cauca e nas outras regiões afetadas, o perigo imediato do terremoto pode ter passado, mas a tarefa mais difícil — reconstruir cidades, localizar os desaparecidos e encontrar abrigo permanente para dezenas de milhares de pessoas — está apenas começando.

in.title: 281 Tewas, 12.000 Rumah Hancur: Di Dalam Pencarian Korban Hilang Kolombia Setelah Gempa Terburuk dalam Satu Abad

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: Lebih dari dua minggu setelah bumi mengguncang bagian barat Kolombia hingga ke dasarnya, tim penyelamat masih bekerja di lingkungan yang runtuh, berharap dapat menemukan korban selamat — atau setidaknya jawaban — bagi ratusan keluarga yang masih menunggu kabar tentang orang tercinta yang hilang.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## Apa yang terjadi

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: Pada 10 Agustus 2026, gempa berkekuatan magnitudo 7,4 melanda dekat kota San José del Palmar di departemen Chocó, Kolombia, salah satu wilayah termiskin dan terpencil di negara tersebut.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: Gempa tersebut diikuti oleh serangkaian gempa susulan, beberapa di antaranya cukup kuat untuk merobohkan bangunan yang sudah melemah, dan dengan cepat digambarkan oleh para ahli seismologi sebagai yang terkuat yang pernah melanda Kolombia pada abad ke-21.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: Guncangan tersebut terasa jauh melampaui pusat gempa.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: Kota-kota termasuk Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, dan Manizales semuanya melaporkan kerusakan parah, mulai dari blok apartemen yang retak hingga keruntuhan bangunan total.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: Cali, salah satu kota terbesar di Kolombia, telah muncul sebagai pusat perkotaan yang paling parah terkena dampak, dengan pejabat setempat melaporkan puluhan kematian dan lebih dari seribu korban luka di dalam kota saja.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## Jumlah korban tewas yang terus meningkat

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: Menurut badan penanggulangan bencana nasional Kolombia, UNGRD, jumlah korban tewas yang dikonfirmasi terus meningkat sejak gempa pertama kali melanda, berdiri di angka 281 dalam penghitungan resmi terbaru.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: Ribuan lainnya terluka, dan beberapa ratus orang masih terdaftar sebagai hilang — angka yang perlahan turun saat kru pencari bekerja melalui reruntuhan di kota-kota yang terkena dampak parah.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: Operasi pencarian dan penyelamatan telah diperumit oleh medan itu sendiri.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar wilayah Chocó adalah hutan lebat dan pedesaan pegunungan dengan sedikit jalan beraspal, dan tanah longsor yang dipicu oleh gempa dan gempa susulannya memblokir beberapa rute yang dibutuhkan konvoi penyelamat untuk mencapai desa-desa terpencil.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: Pada hari-hari segera setelah bencana, beberapa komunitas hanya dapat dicapai dengan helikopter atau berjalan kaki.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## Puluhan ribu orang kehilangan tempat tinggal

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: Kerugian material sangat mencengangkan.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: Perkiraan pemerintah menempatkan jumlah rumah yang hancur di atas 12.000, dengan puluhan ribu lainnya rusak hingga tidak aman untuk ditempati.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: Para pejabat mengatakan gempa bumi telah mempengaruhi orang-orang di lebih dari belasan departemen dan ratusan kotamadya, membuat puluhan ribu warga Kolombia mengungsi dan membutuhkan tempat perlindungan darurat.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: Di kota-kota yang paling parah terkena dampak, tenda-tenda darurat dan terpal telah didirikan di alun-alun, halaman sekolah, dan lapangan terbuka, saat keluarga yang kehilangan rumah mereka menunggu kabar tentang perumahan jangka panjang.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: Kelompok bantuan dan lembaga pemerintah telah mendistribusikan makanan, air, dan pasokan medis, meskipun para pejabat telah mengakui bahwa mencapai komunitas terpencil tetap menjadi tantangan berminggu-minggu setelah tanggapan dimulai.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## Jalan di depan

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: Pemerintah Kolombia telah berjanji dukungan untuk rekonstruksi di departemen yang terkena dampak, dan organisasi bantuan internasional telah bergabung dalam tanggapan bersama lembaga nasional.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: Tetapi dengan begitu banyak komunitas yang masih terisolasi oleh infrastruktur yang rusak, dan dengan tim pencari yang masih menyisir reruntuhan untuk mencari orang hilang, para pejabat berhati-hati dalam memprediksi kapan fase pemulihan akan sepenuhnya mengambil alih dari upaya pencarian dan penyelamatan.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: Bagi keluarga di Chocó, Valle del Cauca, dan wilayah terdampak lainnya, bahaya langsung dari gempa bumi mungkin telah berlalu, tetapi tugas yang lebih berat — membangun kembali kota-kota, melacak orang hilang, dan menemukan tempat perlindungan permanen bagi puluhan ribu orang — baru saja dimulai.

ja.title: 281人が死亡、1.2万軒の家屋が消滅：1世紀で最悪の地震に見舞われたコロンビアにおける行方不明者捜索の内幕

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## 何が起きたのか

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: 2026年8月10日、コロンビアで最も貧しく最もへんぴな地域の一つであるチョコ県のサン・ホセ・デル・パルマル町近郊を震源とするM7.4の地震が発生した。

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: 地震の後には一連の余震が発生し、その中にはすでに弱っていた建物を倒壊させるほどの強いものもあり、地震学者らによってたちまち21世紀にコロンビアを襲った中で最も強力な地震であると表現された。

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: 揺れは震源からはるか遠くまで到達した。

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: カリ、ペレイラ、キブド、マニサレスなどの都市では、ひび割れたアパートから完全な建物の倒壊に至るまで、深刻な被害が報告された。

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: コロンビア最大級の都市であるカリは、最も深刻な被害を受けた都市中心部として浮上しており、市内でだけでも地元当局により数十人の死亡と1000人を超える負傷者が報告されている。

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## 増え続ける死者数

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: コロンビアの国家災害管理機関（UNGRD）によると、地震発生以来、確認された死者数は着実に増加しており、最新の公式集計では281人に達している。

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: さらに数千人が負傷し、数百人が依然として行方不明者としてリストアップされている。この数は、被害の大きかった町で捜索隊ががれきの撤去作業を進めるにつれて、ようやく少しずつ減少してきたものである。

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: 捜索救助活動は地形そのものによって複雑化している。

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: チョコ県の大部分は、舗装道路がほとんどない密林と山岳地帯であり、地震とその余震によって引き起こされた地滑りが、救援部隊が孤立した村々に到達するために必要な複数のルートを塞いだ。

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: 災害直後の数日間は、ヘリコプターか徒歩でしか到達できない地域もあった。

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## 家を失った数万人の人々

segments.tr: 物的被害は驚異的な規模に達している。

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: 政府の推計によると、全壊した家屋の数は1万2000棟を超え、さらに数万棟が居住するのに危険なレベルの被害を受けている。

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: 当局によれば、この地震は十数以上の県と数百の自治体にわたる人々に影響を与えており、数万人のコロンビア人が家を追われ、緊急避難所を必要としているという。

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: 被害が最も大きかった町では、家を失った家族が長期的な住居に関する知らせを待つ間、広場や校庭、空き地にテントや防水シートによる仮設キャンプが設置されている。

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: 支援団体や政府機関が食料、水、医療品の配布を行っているが、対応開始から数週間が経過した現在でも、最もへんぴな地域に到達することは依然として課題であると当局は認めている。

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## 今後の道のり

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: コロンビア政府は被災した県における復興支援を誓約しており、国内の機関に加えて国際的な支援団体も対応に加わっている。

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: しかし、インフラの損壊によって依然として多くのコミュニティが孤立しており、捜索チームが依然として行方不明者を求めてがれきを捜索している中、当局は、いつ復旧段階が捜索救助活動から完全に引き継がれるか予測することについては慎重な姿勢をとっている。

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: チョコ県、バジェ・デル・カウカ県、その他の被災地域の家族にとって、地震の差し迫った危険は去ったかもしれないが、町を再建し、行方不明者を追跡し、数万人の人々に恒久的な住居を見つけるという、より困難な課題は始まったばかりである。

de.title: 281 Tote, 12.000 zerstörte Häuser: Einblicke in Kolumbiens Suche nach Vermissten nach dem schwersten Erdbeben seit einem Jahrhundert

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: Mehr als zwei Wochen nachdem das Erdbeben den Westen Kolumbiens in seinen Grundfesten erschüttert hat, arbeiten Rettungsteams immer noch in den eingestürzten Vierteln, in der Hoffnung, Überlebende zu finden – oder zumindest Antworten für die Hunderte von Familien, die noch immer auf Nachrichten über ihre vermissten Angehörigen warten.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## Was ist passiert

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: Am 10. August 2026 ereignete sich ein Erdbeben der Stärke 7,4 in der Nähe der Stadt San José del Palmar im kolumbianischen Departement Chocó, einer der ärmsten und entlegensten Regionen des Landes.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: Dem Beben folgte eine Reihe von Nachbeben, von denen einige stark genug waren, um bereits geschwächte Gebäude zum Einsturz zu bringen, und die von Seismologen schnell als die stärksten beschrieben wurden, die Kolumbien im 21. Jahrhundert getroffen haben.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: Die Erschütterungen reichten weit über das Epizentrum hinaus.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: Städte wie Cali, Pereira, Quibdó und Manizales meldeten alle schwere Schäden, von Rissen in Wohnblöcken bis hin zu vollständigen Gebäudeeinstürzen.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: Cali, eine der größten Städte Kolumbiens, hat sich als das am schwersten betroffene urbane Zentrum herausgestellt, wobei lokale Behörden allein in der Stadt Dutzende von Todesfällen und weit über tausend Verletzte gemeldet haben.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## Eine weiter steigende Zahl an Todesopfern

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: Nach Angaben der kolumbianischen Katastrophenschutzbehörde UNGRD ist die Zahl der bestätigten Todesopfer seit dem ersten Beben stetig gestiegen und liegt nach der neuesten offiziellen Zählung bei 281.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: Tausende weitere wurden verletzt, und mehrere hundert Menschen gelten weiterhin als vermisst – eine Zahl, die nur langsam zurückgegangen ist, während Suchtrupps in den schwer betroffenen Städten die Trümmer durchsuchen.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: Such- und Rettungsaktionen wurden durch das Gelände selbst erschwert.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Ein Großteil von Chocó besteht aus dichtem Dschungel und bergiger Landschaft mit wenigen befestigten Straßen, und Erdrutsche, die durch das Beben und seine Nachbeben ausgelöst wurden, blockierten mehrere Routen, die Rettungskonvois benötigten, um isolierte Dörfer zu erreichen.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: In den Tagen unmittelbar nach der Katastrophe waren einige Gemeinden nur per Hubschrauber oder zu Fuß erreichbar.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## Zehntausende ohne Obdach

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: Der materielle Schaden ist erschütternd.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: Regierungsschätzungen gehen von über 12.000 zerstörten Häusern aus, wobei Zehntausende weitere so stark beschädigt sind, dass sie nicht mehr bewohnbar sind.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: Beamte sagen, dass das Erdbeben Menschen in mehr als einem Dutzend Departements und Hunderten von Gemeinden betroffen hat, was Zehntausende Kolumbianer vertrieben hat und Notunterkünfte erforderlich macht.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: In den am schwersten betroffenen Städten wurden provisorische Lager mit Zelten und Planen auf Plätzen, Schulhöfen und offenen Feldern errichtet, während Familien, die ihre Häuser verloren haben, auf Informationen über langfristige Unterkünfte warten.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: Hilfsorganisationen und Regierungsbehörden verteilen Lebensmittel, Wasser und medizinische Hilfsgüter, obwohl Beamte eingeräumt haben, dass das Erreichen der entlegensten Gemeinden auch Wochen nach Beginn der Hilfsmaßnahmen eine Herausforderung bleibt.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## Der Weg, der vor uns liegt

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: Die kolumbianische Regierung hat Unterstützung für den Wiederaufbau in den betroffenen Departements zugesagt, und internationale Hilfsorganisationen haben sich den nationalen Behörden bei der Reaktion angeschlossen.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: Aber da so viele Gemeinden immer noch durch beschädigte Infrastruktur abgeschnitten sind und Suchteams immer noch die Trümmer nach Vermissten durchkämmen, sind die Behörden vorsichtig mit Prognosen, wann die Wiederaufbauphase die Such- und Rettungsbemühungen vollständig ablösen wird.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: Für die Familien in Chocó, Valle del Cauca und den anderen betroffenen Regionen mag die unmittelbare Gefahr des Erdbebens vorüber sein, aber die schwierigere Aufgabe – der Wiederaufbau der Städte, die Suche nach den Vermissten und die Suche nach dauerhaften Unterkünften für Zehntausende von Menschen – hat gerade erst begonnen.

vi.title: 281 người chết, 12.000 ngôi nhà bị phá hủy: Bên trong cuộc tìm kiếm những người mất tích của Colombia sau trận động đất tồi tệ nhất trong một thế kỷ

segments.src: More than two weeks after the ground shook western Colombia to its core, rescue teams are still working through collapsed neighborhoods, hoping to find survivors — or at least answers — for the hundreds of families still waiting for news of missing loved ones.
segments.tr: Hơn hai tuần sau khi mặt đất rung chuyển miền tây Colombia đến tận gốc rễ, các đội cứu hộ vẫn đang nỗ lực làm việc qua những khu phố sụp đổ, hy vọng tìm thấy những người sống sót — hoặc ít nhất là câu trả lời — cho hàng trăm gia đình vẫn đang chờ đợi tin tức về những người thân yêu mất tích.

segments.src: ## What happened
segments.tr: ## Chuyện gì đã xảy ra

segments.src: On August 10, 2026, a magnitude-7.4 earthquake struck near the town of San José del Palmar in Colombia's Chocó department, one of the country's poorest and most remote regions.
segments.tr: Vào ngày 10 tháng 8 năm 2026, một trận động đất mạnh 7,4 độ richter đã tấn công gần thị trấn San José del Palmar thuộc tỉnh Chocó của Colombia, một trong những vùng nghèo nhất và xa xôi nhất của đất nước.

segments.src: The quake was followed by a series of aftershocks, some strong enough to bring down already-weakened buildings, and was quickly described by seismologists as the most powerful to hit Colombia in the 21st century.
segments.tr: Trận động đất được nối tiếp bởi một loạt dư chấn, một số trận đủ mạnh để đánh sập các tòa nhà vốn đã suy yếu, và nhanh chóng được các nhà địa chấn học mô tả là trận mạnh nhất tấn công Colombia trong thế kỷ 21.

segments.src: The shaking reached far beyond the epicenter.
segments.tr: Dư chấn lan rộng ra xa ngoài tâm chấn.

segments.src: Cities including Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, and Manizales all reported serious damage, from cracked apartment blocks to full building collapses.
segments.tr: Các thành phố bao gồm Cali, Pereira, Quibdó và Manizales đều báo cáo thiệt hại nghiêm trọng, từ các khu chung cư bị nứt đến các tòa nhà sụp đổ hoàn toàn.

segments.src: Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, has emerged as the hardest-hit urban center, with local officials reporting dozens of deaths and well over a thousand injuries within the city alone.
segments.tr: Cali, một trong những thành phố lớn nhất của Colombia, đã nổi lên là trung tâm đô thị chịu thiệt hại nặng nề nhất, với các quan chức địa phương báo cáo hàng chục người chết và hơn một nghìn người bị thương chỉ tính riêng trong thành phố.

segments.src: ## A death toll still climbing
segments.tr: ## Số người chết vẫn tiếp tục tăng

segments.src: According to Colombia's national disaster management agency, UNGRD, the confirmed death toll has climbed steadily since the quake first hit, standing at 281 in the latest official count.
segments.tr: Theo cơ quan quản lý thảm họa quốc gia của Colombia, UNGRD, số người chết được xác nhận đã tăng đều đặn kể từ khi trận động đất lần đầu tiên xảy ra, ở mức 281 trong số liệu chính thức mới nhất.

segments.src: Thousands more were injured, and several hundred people remain listed as missing — a number that has only slowly come down as search crews work through debris in hard-hit towns.
segments.tr: Hàng ngàn người khác bị thương, và vài trăm người vẫn được liệt kê là mất tích — một con số chỉ giảm xuống từ từ khi các đội tìm kiếm làm việc qua đống đổ nát ở các thị trấn bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề.

segments.src: Search and rescue operations have been complicated by the terrain itself.
segments.tr: Các hoạt động tìm kiếm và cứu nạn đã trở nên phức tạp bởi chính địa hình.

segments.src: Much of Chocó is dense jungle and mountainous countryside with few paved roads, and landslides triggered by the quake and its aftershocks blocked several routes that rescue convoys needed to reach isolated villages.
segments.tr: Phần lớn Chocó là rừng rậm rạp và vùng nông thôn miền núi với ít đường trải nhựa, và các vụ lở đất do trận động đất cùng các dư chấn gây ra đã chặn một số tuyến đường mà các đoàn cứu hộ cần để đến các ngôi làng cô lập.

segments.src: In the days immediately after the disaster, some communities were reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
segments.tr: Trong những ngày ngay sau thảm họa, một số cộng đồng chỉ có thể tiếp cận bằng trực thăng hoặc đi bộ.

segments.src: ## Tens of thousands without homes
segments.tr: ## Hàng chục ngàn người không có nhà ở

segments.src: The material toll has been staggering.
segments.tr: Tổn thất vật chất thật đáng kinh ngạc.

segments.src: Government estimates put the number of destroyed homes above 12,000, with tens of thousands more damaged to the point of being unsafe to occupy.
segments.tr: Các ước tính của chính phủ đặt số lượng nhà bị phá hủy lên tới hơn 12.000 căn, với hàng chục ngàn căn khác bị hư hỏng đến mức không an toàn để ở.

segments.src: Officials say the earthquake has affected people across more than a dozen departments and hundreds of municipalities, leaving tens of thousands of Colombians displaced and in need of emergency shelter.
segments.tr: Các quan chức cho biết trận động đất đã ảnh hưởng đến người dân ở hơn một chục tỉnh và hàng trăm đô thị, khiến hàng chục ngàn người Colombia phải di dời và cần nơi trú ẩn khẩn cấp.

segments.src: In the hardest-hit towns, temporary camps of tents and tarps have gone up in plazas, schoolyards, and open fields, as families who lost their homes wait for word on longer-term housing.
segments.tr: Tại các thị trấn bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề nhất, các trại tạm thời làm bằng lều và bạt đã mọc lên ở các quảng trường, sân trường và cánh đồng mở, khi các gia đình mất nhà cửa chờ đợi thông tin về nhà ở lâu dài hơn.

segments.src: Aid groups and government agencies have been distributing food, water, and medical supplies, though officials have acknowledged that reaching the most remote communities remains a challenge weeks into the response.
segments.tr: Các nhóm cứu trợ và cơ quan chính phủ đã phân phát thực phẩm, nước uống và vật tư y tế, mặc dù các quan chức thừa nhận rằng việc tiếp cận các cộng đồng xa xôi nhất vẫn là một thách thức nhiều tuần sau khi phản ứng.

segments.src: ## The road ahead
segments.tr: ## Con đường phía trước

segments.src: Colombia's government has pledged support for reconstruction in the affected departments, and international aid organizations have joined the response alongside national agencies.
segments.tr: Chính phủ Colombia đã cam kết hỗ trợ tái thiết ở các tỉnh bị ảnh hưởng, và các tổ chức viện trợ quốc tế đã tham gia ứng phó cùng với các cơ quan quốc gia.

segments.src: But with so many communities still cut off by damaged infrastructure, and with search teams still combing through rubble for the missing, officials have been cautious about predicting when the recovery phase will fully take over from the search-and-rescue effort.
segments.tr: Nhưng với quá nhiều cộng đồng vẫn bị cắt đứt bởi cơ sở hạ tầng bị hư hỏng, và với các đội tìm kiếm vẫn đang lùng sục qua đống đổ nát để tìm những người mất tích, các quan chức đã thận trọng khi dự đoán khi nào giai đoạn phục hồi sẽ hoàn toàn tiếp quản từ nỗ lực tìm kiếm cứu nạn.

segments.src: For families in Chocó, Valle del Cauca, and the other affected regions, the earthquake's immediate danger may have passed, but the harder task — rebuilding towns, tracing the missing, and finding permanent shelter for tens of thousands of people — is only just beginning.
segments.tr: Đối với các gia đình ở Chocó, Valle del Cauca và các khu vực bị ảnh hưởng khác, mối nguy hiểm tức thời của trận động đất có thể đã qua, nhưng nhiệm vụ khó khăn hơn — xây dựng lại các thị trấn, truy tìm những người mất tích và tìm nơi ở vĩnh viễn cho hàng chục ngàn người — chỉ mới bắt đầu.
